title: Cebu sets P400M disaster plan for 2027; preparedness takes priority

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Disaster preparedness will take the biggest share of Cebu Province’s proposed ₱400-million disaster risk reduction and management funding for 2027. The allocation forms part of the proposed Annual Investment Plan (AIP) of the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO), which the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council approved on September 17. The council approved the proposal during their third-quarter meeting, with Provincial Administrator Atty. Ace Durano presiding, according to the Provincial Information Office (PIO).
